notes: perImage is OpenAI's per-image OUTPUT price table (image output tokens only). The text prompt (~chars/4 tokens at the textInput rate) and every reference image passed to /v1/images/edits (inputTokensPerReferenceImage at the imageInput rate) are billed on top; scripts/fitness-images.py estimates all three and records the actual cost from the response `usage` field.

Validated against 2,961 real gpt-image-2 calls logged by the sibling recipe generator (../recipes/generated/**/usage.jsonl): medium 1536x1024 = 1372 output image tokens = $0.0412 (table says $0.041); medium 1024x1024 = 1756 = $0.0527 ($0.053); high 1536x1024 = 5488 = $0.165; every 1536x1024 reference image = 1536 input image tokens; text prompts of ~5,000 characters = ~1,300 input tokens.
gpt-image-1 was shut down on 2026-10-23 (OpenAI model page), so the fallback is gpt-image-1-mini (listed as deprecated, still priced). Its per-image table is OpenAI's.
Cached-input rates apply only to the Responses API image tool, not to direct /v1/images requests. Batch API prices are half the standard token rates but are not used here.
